questions.stem: A 5-year-old boy is brought to the emergency department with a history of profuse watery diarrhea and multiple episodes of vomiting for the past 3 days. On examination, he appears lethargic, has poor oral acceptance, and has dry mucous membranes. Laboratory tests reveal serum potassium of 2.8 mEq/L. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial treatment for this patient?
